fact: Thorin delivers a twelve-point feinting strike to the enlarged, invisible duergar, knocking him unconscious instead of killing him.
source_quote: Thorin delivered a twelve-point feinting strike, and the GM ruled the enlarged slaver knocked unconscious rather than killed.
subject: duergar slaver incapacitated

fact: The duergar slaver shrinks back to his normal small size as the enlarging magic fades.
source_quote: As the magic faded, the duergar shrank back to his normal small size.
subject: duergar slaver

fact: Buppido offers his services as an expert interrogator, claiming to have many techniques.
source_quote: Buppido cheerfully offered his services as an expert interrogator with "many techniques."
subject: Buppido

fact: Sarith declares himself an expert in questioning techniques due to his background as a guard of Lolth.
source_quote: Sarith, not to be outdone, declared that as one of Lolth's own guards he too was an expert in questioning techniques.
subject: Sarith

fact: Sarith admits that Daz's recent questioning techniques have been impressive.
source_quote: He then paused to allow that Daz's techniques had been most impressive of late.
subject: Sarith

fact: Spiderbait states he will leave the party at the next opportunity.
source_quote: Spiderbait, rescued but deeply shaken, made it clear he would leave at the next opportunity.
subject: Spiderbait

fact: Spiderbait notes that his best friend is dead and he was attacked by a demon lord.
source_quote: He quietly noted that his best friend was dead and he had been attacked by a demon lord.
subject: Spiderbait

fact: Spiderbait expresses his desire to leave by saying he is getting out at the next place he can.
source_quote: next place I can get out of here, I'm getting out of here.
subject: Spiderbait

fact: Thorin reminds Spiderbait that the party saved him.
source_quote: Thorin: "We saved you, Spiderbait."
subject: Thorin

fact: The party captures the duergar keelboat, expanding their fleet.
source_quote: The duergar keelboat was captured, giving the group a small armada
subject: duergar keelboat

fact: The chest aboard the duergar keelboat contains 1,100 gold pieces.
source_quote: the chest aboard yielded 1,100 gold pieces
subject: gold

fact: Daz rolls 3d6 multiplied by 100 to determine the amount of gold in the chest.
source_quote: Daz rolls 3d6 (× 100) for the gold, and the chest holds 1,100 gold pieces.
subject: gold roll

fact: Zalthir notes that the gold allows the party to pay back Spiderbait.
source_quote: Zalthir notes the gold means they can pay back Spiderbait.
subject: Zalthir

fact: The party acquires a magical alchemy jug from the chest.
source_quote: a remarkable magical alchemy jug.
subject: alchemy jug

fact: The alchemy jug holds a gallon and weighs 12 pounds regardless of content.
source_quote: The jug holds a gallon, weighs 12 pounds full or empty
subject: alchemy jug

fact: The alchemy jug produces a chosen liquid until dawn, when the choice resets.
source_quote: can be set to produce a chosen liquid until dawn.
subject: alchemy jug

fact: The GM notes that the alchemy jug solves the party's water supply problem.
source_quote: The GM notes the jug means the party "never have to worry about water again."
subject: alchemy jug

fact: The party decides to set the alchemy jug to produce mayonnaise instead of acid or poison.
source_quote: They then turned to the merits of producing mayonnaise instead of the more tactical acid or poison
subject: mayonnaise selection

fact: Daz expresses enthusiasm for fish with mayonnaise and a fungus cake sandwich.
source_quote: Daz was enthusiastic about fish with mayonnaise and a "fungus cake, mayonnaise, fungus cake" sandwich.
subject: Daz's reaction

fact: The party secures two casks made of zurkhwood containing harvested fungi.
source_quote: The group also secured two casks of harvested fungi
subject: zurkhwood casks

fact: The harvested fungi in the casks will serve as food supplies for the party.
source_quote: ensuring they would not go hungry in the days ahead.
subject: zurkhwood casks

fact: The GM rules that mayonnaise produced by the jug remains stable for two weeks.
source_quote: He rules mayonnaise stays stable for two weeks.
subject: mayonnaise

fact: The GM notes that most people choose poison to coat weapons rather than condiments.
source_quote: He notes most people choose poison to coat weapons.
subject: GM commentary

fact: The GM remarks that mayonnaise on mushrooms with a little acid makes tartar sauce.
source_quote: The GM riffs that mayonnaise on mushrooms, with "a little bit of acid, just a little bit," makes tartar sauce.
subject: GM riff

fact: The party prepares to interrogate the captured duergar to find the way to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The party prepares to interrogate their prisoner to find the way to Gracklstugh.
subject: interrogation plan

fact: The GM notes that the duergar is more interested in profit than being a hero.
source_quote: The GM reminds them the duergar is "more interested in profit than … being a hero."
subject: duergar slaver
